ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing allof the
RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)and B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-F in the area bound by:

      a line l92feetsouth of and parallel to West 35th Street; the alley next east of and
      parallel to South Hasted Street;West 36th Street; and, South Halsted Street

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
